environment.description: EKS pod running in a private subnet (10.0.4.0/24) with a NAT gateway attached to the route table (rtb-0a3f7c9e2d). The pod has network access to the RDS PostgreSQL instance (pg-prod-users.cluster-xyz.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com) on port 5432 and to the Kafka broker cluster (MSK) on ports 9092-9094. The pod's service account has no restrictive network policies applied. Outbound internet access is available through the NAT gateway for webhook delivery. The Kafka topic 'user-registrations' accepts messages from any authenticated producer.

config.db_user_permissions: INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE on users table
